description: Ingest Totango Account records via the Totango Search API (POST /api/v1/search/accounts) and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of Totango account records with the configured fields as columns

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the TotangoResource this asset depends on for authentication

terms.label: Terms
terms.description: Raw Totango Search API 'terms' filter conditions

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Account fields to return. Custom attribute names (e.g. health scores) are configured per Totango org.

date_term_name.label: Date Term Name
date_term_name.description: Attribute name used to build the optional modified-date range term (static or partition-derived)

modified_after.label: Modified After
modified_after.description: Static lower bound (ISO-8601) for date_term_name. Ignored when a time-based partition_type is set.

modified_before.label: Modified Before
modified_before.description: Static upper bound (ISO-8601) for date_term_name. Ignored when a time-based partition_type is set.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Totango search scope, if applicable to your org

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to fetch across all pages

count.label: Count (Page Size)
count.description: Accounts requested per page. Totango caps this at 1000.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:customer-success) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['totango', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Totango Accounts Ingestion
